item.title: Overflowing bins obstructing the pavement, 26th September
item.description:
Overflowing wheelie bins continue to obstruct the pavement and present a health hazard outside this property. Sack of domestic and food rubbish are being thrown onto the drive and allowed to spill onto the pavement, attracting flies, vermin and fixes. The rotting food stinks and is offensive to pedestrians and other residents. Refuse collection teams refuse to empty the bins as they are over full and the sanitary problem worsens on a weekly basis. A disused fridge has been dumped on the drive which presents a health/chemical hazard as well as a danger to children should they attempt to climb into it. RBG personnel need to inspect this site as a matter of safety and urgency.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Greenvale Road, Eltham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Wooden posts are pulled out, 26th September
item.description:

This is damaging the green space and, more importantly, creates a safety risk for children who play in the area, as vehicles are driving through the grass where children may be playing.
